videos.subtitle_summary:
1.  Analyze the Request:
Source Material: A YouTube video transcript about the Bank of Korea's decision to freeze the base interest rate.
Title: "한은 신현송 총재 첫 금통위, 기준금리 동결 결정 / YTN" (Bank of Korea Governor Hyeon-sung Shin's first Monetary Policy Committee meeting, decision to freeze base rate / YTN).
Task: Summarize the transcript in Korean.
Length: Around 500 characters (Korean characters).
Constraints:
MUST respond ONLY in Korean.
Do NOT use English at all.
Summarize core content in 3-5 sentences.
2.  Analyze the Source Text (Transcript):
Key Point 1: Bank of Korea froze the base rate at 2.5% annually. This is the 8th consecutive freeze since last July.
Key Point 2: It was Governor Shin Hyeon-sung's first meeting. Despite his hawkish reputation and market speculation of a hike, they chose to freeze for now.
Key Point 3: Reasons for freeze: Iran conflict (high oil prices), high exchange rates, surging producer/consumer prices.
Key Point 4: Economic Outlook: Growth forecast raised from 2.0% to 2.6% due to semiconductor exports. However, inflation forecast raised from 2.2% to 2.7% due to geopolitical risks and supplementary budget.
Key Point 5: Market reaction: KOSPI opened lower, mixed trends for Samsung/SK Hynix. KRW/USD exchange rate remains high (over 1500 won).
Future Outlook: Expectation of 1-2 rate hikes in the second half of the year.
3.  Drafting the Summary (Iterative Process):
Draft 1 (Mental Outline): The Bank of Korea kept the base rate at 2.5% for the 8th time. This was Governor Shin's first meeting. Even though he is hawkish, they froze it due to high oil prices and inflation. The growth forecast went up to 2.6%, but inflation forecast also went up to 2.7%. People expect a rate hike later this year. The stock market was mixed, and the exchange rate is high.
